en-US.longDescription: The Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client. Chat freely, create boldly, and bring ideas to life.
en-US.name: Xiaomi MiMo AI
en-US.publisher: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
en-US.releaseNotes:
External agents can connect to MiMo through the agent gateway, with streamlined onboarding and expanded contact support.
Desktop robots support richer interactions, including selectable behaviors, return-to-origin, and responses triggered by physical interaction.
Conversation links can open in the built-in browser or the system browser, according to a new preference.
Thinking-level settings follow each model’s supported capabilities and remain independently configured across conversations.
Messages sent during task execution are queued and delivered in order after the current turn completes.
Performance improvements for a smoother experience.
Fixed several known issues.
